statement.p: Calculate \int_C ((8 x + 2 y)\,\vec i + (4 x + 6 y)\,\vec j)\cdot d\vec r where C is the circular path with center (a, b) and radius m, oriented counterclockwise. Use Green's Theorem.

p.m: \int_C ((8 x + 2 y)\,\vec i + (4 x + 6 y)\,\vec j)\cdot d\vec r =

solution.me: \int_C (((8 x+2 y)\,\vec i + (4 x + 6 y)\,\vec j )\cdot d\vec r = \int\!\!\!\int_R \left(-\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(8 x+2 y) + \frac{\partial}{\partial x}(4 x+6 y)\right) dA
